nodes.description: Constant maximum total supply of 4900 NFTs.
Constant maximum number of tokens (50) that may be reserved by the owner.
Constant maximum number of tokens (20) mintable per wallet.
Public mint price in wei, 0.111 ether, owner-settable value.
Boolean sale state flag toggled by the owner.
Running count of all minted tokens, updated in mint and reserveTokens.
Running count of reserved tokens, updated in reserveTokens.
Private metadata base URI string used by tokenURI.
Fixed array of 4900 uint ids used as the unique token id picker pool.
Private counter of tokens already drawn from the ids pool.
Mapping tracking number of tokens minted per wallet for the per-wallet cap.
Constructor setting ERC721 name/symbol and the default baseURI.
Internal override returning the stored baseURI.
Public view returning concatenated baseURI, decimal tokenId and .json suffix.
Owner-only function updating the metadata base URI.
Owner-only function flipping isSaleActive.
Owner-only function that reserves up to MAX_RESERVED tokens using a pseudo-random id draw.
Payable public mint function enforcing sale state, per-wallet cap and exact ETH payment.
Private swap-and-pop style function deriving a unique token id from a seed and pool state.
Owner-only function splitting the contract balance to three fixed payout addresses.
Public burn function restricted to owner or approved operator of the tokenId.
Private function performing an external call to onERC721Received on contract recipients.
Internal safe mint that mints then calls the ERC721 receiver hook.
Internal mint updating balances and owners mappings.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, reserving, burning and randomness seeding.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as part of the pseudo-random seed.
External call to recipient contract hook during safe minting, reentrancy vector before finalization semantics.
Three payable transfers of computed balance fractions to hardcoded addresses.
Additions totalReserved + amount and totalMinted + amount bounded by cap requires.
Multiplication amount * price compared against msg.value and additive per-wallet counter update.
Owner-supplied number of tokens to reserve.
Caller-supplied number of tokens to mint in one transaction.
Owner-supplied new metadata base URI.
Caller-supplied token id to burn.
Seed value supplied by mint or reserveTokens for the id draw.
Local keccak256 seed from index, msg.sender and block.timestamp in reserveTokens.
Local keccak256 seed from index, msg.sender and block.timestamp in mint.
Local cached contract balance distributed by withdraw.
Local remaining pool length computed as ids.length - index++.

edges.reason: mint is callable by any msg.sender and keys per-wallet accounting on the caller.
reserveTokens mints to msg.sender and seeds randomness with the caller address.
burn uses _msgSender() in the approval check for the tokenId.
Randomness seed in reserveTokens directly depends on block.timestamp, a miner-influenced value.
mint seed _random incorporates block.timestamp, making id selection timestamp dependent.
mint requires isSaleActive before any payment or minting logic executes.
mint compares amount * price against msg.value.
mint reads and updates addressToNumMinted to enforce the per-wallet cap.
mint increments totalMinted for each successfully minted batch.
reserveTokens increments totalMinted and checks it against MAX_SUPPLY.
reserveTokens increments totalReserved and checks it against MAX_RESERVED.
require enforces totalReserved + amount <= MAX_RESERVED.
require enforces totalMinted + amount <= MAX_SUPPLY.
_pickRandomUniqueId reads and rewrites the ids pool array.
_pickRandomUniqueId consumes and post-increments index to compute remaining length.
reserveTokens passes its generated seed into _pickRandomUniqueId.
mint passes its generated seed into _pickRandomUniqueId.
reserveTokens mints via _safeMint, invoking recipient hooks while reserve state is still being updated.
mint calls _safeMint inside a loop, granting external control flow to recipient contracts mid-transaction.
_safeMint first performs the internal _mint bookkeeping before the receiver check.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received which performs the external hook call.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the untrusted external onERC721Received call on the recipient.
withdraw computes balance fractions and forwards them through the hardcoded payout transfers.
mint performs amount * price and additive counter arithmetic that must be exact and overflow-free.
reserveTokens performs additive cap arithmetic on totalReserved and totalMinted.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI reads baseURI to build the metadata string.
burn calls _burn after the caller authorization check on msg.sender.
toggleSaleState flips isSaleActive, gating whether mint can proceed.
The amount parameter drives the reserve loop, cap checks and totalReserved update.
The amount parameter drives mint loop count, payment requirement and per-wallet accounting.
The uri parameter is stored directly into baseURI by setBaseURI.
The tokenId parameter is checked against the caller approval before burning.
The random parameter is consumed by the modulo and swap-and-pop id selection.
_random local feeds _pickRandomUniqueId from within reserveTokens.
_random local feeds _pickRandomUniqueId from within mint.
balance local caches address(this).balance for the payout fractions.
len local bounds the random index and the pool swap-and-pop operations.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is only meaningful as the reserve loop bound and cap operand of reserveTokens.
Parameter is consumed solely by mint for loop count, payment validation and wallet accounting.
Parameter is written straight into baseURI inside the owner-only setter.
Parameter is used only for the approval check and _burn call in burn.
Parameter is the sole seed input of the id selection routine.
Local seed is computed and immediately passed to _pickRandomUniqueId within reserveTokens.
Local seed is computed and immediately passed to _pickRandomUniqueId within mint.
Local cached balance is only used to compute the three payout fractions in withdraw.
Local pool length is only used inside the id selection routine for indexing and swaps.
